newsitem.title: USA: International Flavors sees lower Q3 EPS.
newsitem.headline: International Flavors sees lower Q3 EPS.

text.p: International Flavors & Fragrances said on Tuesday it expected its third-quarter net income to be in the range of $0.47 per share and $0.49 per share.
For the third quarter last year, International Flavors posted net income of $0.57 per share.

But the company also said it expected its fourth-quarter results to increase compared to the same period last year. Overall, the company said its year-end earnings should be in the range of $1.71 per share and $1.76 per share, including a charge of $0.29 per share in the 1996 second quarter.
First Call consensus estimates for the flavor and fragrance company were $2.24 per share for the 1996 fiscal year, $0.62 for the third quarter and $0.45 per share for the fourth quarter.
The company posted $0.36 per share for the fourth quarter last year.

Flavor sales will be softer in the third quarter because some of the company's U.S. food customers are downsizing and restructuring their operations. Also, the cool and wet summer in both the United States and Europe meant lower flavor sales to the beverage, ice cream and yogurt industries.
The company said orders for fragrances were picking up from the first half of the year but were not back to "normal ordering patterns" because of economic conditions in Europe.
